name: EU Blue Card

requirements.blocker_text: This requires a confirmed job offer — unlike Highly Skilled Migrant, the employer does NOT need IND-recognised sponsor status for a Blue Card application.

This requires a diploma from a higher-education programme of at least 3 years (evaluated by Nuffic if foreign), OR at least 5 years of relevant work experience at higher-education level — for IT managers/specialists, only 3 years of relevant experience within the preceding 7 years is needed.

notes: SCHEMA GAP CLOSED (2026-08-08): degree-eligibility requirement now cites ind.nl directly (page updated 15 June 2026), replacing the earlier tier-2 EU Immigration Portal citation. Status moved from draft to published. GENUINE NEW FINDING surfaced during the tier-1 re-check, not previously known: Blue Card holders can sometimes reach permanent residence after 2 years instead of the standard 5 (ind.nl 'Exceptions to 5-year term for permanent residency') — not yet modeled as a separate outcome_override since the exact qualifying conditions for the 2-year exception weren't fully detailed on this page and need a follow-up fetch of that specific sub-page before encoding as a hard figure; flagged here rather than guessed. Also confirmed: unemployment search period is 3 months normally, extending to 6 months once the Blue Card has been held 2+ years — a genuine tenure-based benefit not previously captured. Key differentiator from Highly Skilled Migrant, worth surfacing prominently in any comparison view: intra-EU mobility after 12 months, and the employer does NOT need IND-recognised sponsor status — a real practical advantage for smaller/newer employers who haven't gone through sponsor recognition. For under-30 applicants without a degree the HSM route is usually preferable (lower €4,357 threshold, no degree requirement); Blue Card wins specifically where EU-wide mobility matters, or where the 2-year PR exception applies once its exact conditions are confirmed. Same formula-modeling decision as nl_highly_skilled_migrant — literal 2026 values, no fabricated ratio.
